escalation.message: You can't grant {permissions} because you don't hold it.

fixed.humansOnly: This action can only be taken by a signed-in person, not an API key or agent.
fixed.instanceAdminOnly: Only instance admins can open Instance admin.
fixed.sessionExpired: Your session timed out. Sign in again; unsaved work in this tab is kept.
fixed.deactivated: This account is deactivated. Ask an instance admin.
fixed.keyRevoked: This API key is revoked or unknown.
fixed.otherWorkspaceKey: This key belongs to another workspace.
fixed.passwordChange: Replace your temporary password to continue.
fixed.policyUnavailable: Couldn't check the sign-in policy. Try again in a moment.
fixed.twoFactorRequired: Your instance requires two-factor authentication. Add a passkey or an authenticator app to continue.
fixed.whoUnavailable: Couldn't check who you are right now. Try again in a moment.

keyExpired.message: This API key expired on {date, date}. Rotate it in Settings › Keys & MCP.
keyExpired.note: date: Oct 22, 2026, in the reader's region format

problem.notForThisKey.message: This key belongs to {integration} and works only for what {integration} can do. Change what {integration} can do in Settings › Integrations.
problem.notForThisKey.note: integration: an app's name, such as Zapier

problem.integrationOnly: Only an integration's key calls this.
problem.wordpressOnly: Only a WordPress site's key calls this.
problem.keyOnly: Call this with an API key: it describes the key that calls it.
problem.integrationsOff: This API key belongs to an integration, and integrations aren't available on this server.

problem.integrationKeyRevoked.message: This key was revoked. Reconnect {integration} in Settings › Integrations to get a new key.
problem.integrationKeyRevoked.note: integration: an app's name, such as Zapier

problem.integrationKeyExpired.message: This key expired on {date, date}. Reconnect {integration} in Settings › Integrations to get a new key.
problem.integrationKeyExpired.note: date: Oct 22, 2026; integration: an app's name, such as Zapier

problem.ownerLeft.message: The member who owns this key left the workspace, so it has lost its permissions. Someone with integrations:manage can take it over in Settings › Integrations › {integration}; the key stays the same.
problem.ownerLeft.note: integration: an app's name, such as Zapier; integrations:manage is a permission key, never translated

notFound.apiKey.note: api.NotFound(thing): one per kind of thing; a thing without a message reads in English

notFound.question: Question not found.

role.owner.note: the built-in roles; a role someone renamed keeps its name

role.client_approver.note: an agency's client roles, built in in client workspaces
